dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct horizontal white bands are visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and exhibits higher grayscale contrast against the dark wing than the thinner upper band.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharply defined pale-gray to white edges along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers create distinct linear boundaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, horizontally elongated rectangular white patch is present on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, multi-stage linear transition is visible: from a black crown to a white nape patch, and then to a solid gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast white cheek patch and a yellow-tinged wash on the lateral underparts.
